comment: Our pad entities placed in the world by pad_sector.py (docs/design/landing-pads.md, step 8). sector: our sector that holds them (a second sector of our own with its own descriptor did not load, so they share this one). pads: one per visual-only pad, the part entities (pad_entity.py, one per 100 meshes) at the proxy's transform; streaming_distance as far as the hidden proxy drew (its forcedAutoHideDistance); node_id: globalNodeId of the first part, the next ones count up.

pads.note: 499 m tower v2; proxy in exterior_-3_0_0_3, hidden through src/navigation/hidden_nodes.txt
